description: Jev (TypeSafe System One): a decision model, not a chat model. Give it a state (text or JSON) and typed questions; it returns an answer with probabilities for each — use it to classify, route, score or check a claim with calibrated confidence. Question types: "choice" (instructions + criteria: {option: description}), "score" (instructions, scored on a scale) and "noul" (instructions = a statement; returns the probability it is true). $0.05 per 1M input tokens, output free.

questions.description: Questions keyed by your own ids, e.g. {"queue": {"type": "choice", "instructions": "Which queue?", "criteria": {"billing": "Payments and refunds", "bug": "Something is broken"}}, "urgent": {"type": "noul", "instructions": "The customer needs a reply within the hour."}}

state.description: What to decide about: text, or a JSON object / array.

name: jev_decide
